discourse.excerpt: when the bhaktha takes one step towards Him, He takes ten towards him.
discourse.theme: Shed lust, greed, anger and envy to travel light — and the devotee who takes one step toward God finds Him taking ten.
discourse.title: Travel Light

reflection: Swami says there is no shortcut: lust, greed, anger, malice, conceit, envy and hate must be shed to become light for the journey — and the devotee who takes one step toward God finds Him taking ten toward the devotee. Today, set down one weight — one grudge, one craving — and take a single step: one Name repeated with a pure heart. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 4, 8 Dec 1964)
seva_nudge: Lighten someone else's load today — carry a bag, run an errand, or lift a worry by listening — and travel light together.
